definition: the business of keeping people's money
description: Inside a bank vault lit by ceiling lights, a young man in a white shirt and navy waistcoat holds a bundle of banknotes over a long metal drawer pulled out from a wall of small numbered steel safe deposit boxes. A young woman in a burgundy jumper stands beside him holding a small key. He puts the money into the drawer, slides it back into the wall and turns a key in the small door, while she stands behind him. A huge round vault door stands open in the background.

taps.phrase: to put money in a drawer
